This is an application filed on behalf of petitioner nos.5 & 6, inter alia, praying that directions be issued for release of their 2/7th share of the compensation amount in respect of the subject land [comprised of Khasra No.22/18/1(2-07), 22/19/1(2-0), 22/9(4-16) and 22/18/2 (2-07) total measuring 16 Bigha 6 Biswa situated in the Revenue Estate of Village Begumpur, Delhi-110086].
2.

sentences.text: The prayer made in the present application is clearly outside the scope of the controversy in the petition.

4. At this stage, the learned counsel for the applicants (petitioner no. 5 & 6) submits that he may be permitted to withdraw from the writ petition with liberty to pursue other remedies as available under law.
5. In view of the above, petitioner nos.5 & 6 are deleted from the array of parties.
Their challenge to the acquisition of the subject land is closed.
6. This would not preclude petitioner nos.5 and 6 from claiming the compensation, if otherwise entitled, under law.
7. The amended memo of parties be filed by the petitioners before the next date of hearing.
8. The application stands disposed of in above terms.
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners requests for an adjournment.
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Land Acquisition Collector (LAC) also seeks time to file additional affidavit.
Let the same be filed within a period of two weeks from date.

Rejoinder thereto,
if any, be also filed before the next date of hearing.
